name: Basketball Kings 2022
author: Addicting Games
description: Basketball Kings 2022 is a free mobile game. Welcome to the court, king. This is an easy-to-play sports game that will keep you busy for hours. This online game is a fun basketball game where the objective is simply to get the ball in the hoop before the timer runs out. As you play and earn points, unlock all the cool and different colored character skins for your basketball. Additionally, click on the trophy icon to see the target goals that you can earn for bonuses. Your goals depend on what percentage of the game you get through before you lose. On top of challenging yourself, click on the leaderboards icon to compete against other players on this sports game. Climb up the leaderboards and become the best online basketball player for this game!
